Bug_Details:
Leaking resources in an application is never a good idea, as it can lead to memory issues, and even the crash of the application. This rule
template allows you to specify which constructions open a resource and how it is closed in order to raise issue within a method scope when custom
resources are leaked.
Bug_Explanation: The CustomResource instance is opened and processed but never closed, leading to a resource leak.
Trigger_Explanation: The JUnit test case invokes the showBug method of ResourceLeakExample, which processes the CustomResource without closing it, causing a resource leak. This bug is triggered during the test, as the resource is not properly closed after being opened and processed.
